title: COSIS Overlay: Security Controls for SI Developers (SP 800-218A Aligned)

upstream_cosis_source.use_case_designation: UC-DEV: COSIS Overlay: Security Controls for SI Developers (SP 800-218A Aligned)

organization_tailoring.scope_note: Maps MCP 2026-07-28 engineering invariants (MCP-001..008) onto SP 800-53r5 ODPs without claiming finalized federal COSIS mandate.

primary_risks: Compromised CI/CD actions, unpinned dependencies, or malicious build-time schema fetches (SSRF)
AI-synthesized code shipping with silent schema drift, weak error handling, or insecure defaults
Mutable baseline templates drifting out of sync with deployed agent/MCP servers
Unclear separation between authoritative specification rules and unverified LLM suggestions

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Codify reusable secure design patterns (anti-passthrough auth, immutable chassis, dual-axis bounding, cycle-safe schemas) and bake them into Golden Templates rather than relying on ad-hoc developer prompts.

parameter_assignments.sa-08_odp.01: machine-validated MCP-001..MCP-008 secure design patterns enforced via Golden Template

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify Golden Template and pattern catalog pass automated schema and reference tests.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Gate every human and AI-generated commit through layered deterministic verification: static security lint (Ruff/Bandit), strict typechecking, AST hygiene, >= 85% branch coverage, and live transport probes.

parameter_assignments.sa-11_odp.01: 5-gate deterministic verifier (ruff S+T20, mypy --strict, AST audit, pytest >= 85% branch coverage, live stdio probe)

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm CI blocks merge if any verification gate or branch-coverage floor fails.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Pin all third-party CI/CD GitHub Actions to full 40-character commit SHAs, enforce lockfiles (uv.lock), set permissions: contents: read, and disable credential persistence on checkout.

parameter_assignments.sr-03_odp.01: 40-char SHA-pinned GitHub Actions + persist-credentials: false + cryptographic uv.lock

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Audit .github/workflows/*.yml to confirm zero mutable tag references and minimal workflow permissions.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Maintain an immutable Golden Template baseline under version control and enforce lockstep parity between template chassis files and active reference implementations.

parameter_assignments.cm-02_odp.01: golden-template/ chassis synchronized with src/{auth,deps,server}.py and contract tests

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify template chassis files match active server infrastructure without unauthorized drift.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Enforce strict logical write restrictions during automated code generation so synthesis tools can write only domain overlays while chassis and test gates remain locked.

parameter_assignments.cm-05_odp.01: read-only (:ro / 0444 + SHA-256) lock on infrastructure, auth, and contract tests during codegen

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Run tamper-simulation test confirming unauthorized edits to locked paths fail closed.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Sanitize code-generation inputs (blocking external OpenAPI $ref SSRF and '../' path traversal) and record governance artifacts for AppSec review prior to release.

parameter_assignments.sa-15_odp.01: offline deterministic OpenAPI normalization + Stage 5 governance signoff metadata

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm remote $ref URLs and path-traversal refs fail Stage 1 normalization immediately.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Separate the deterministic compliance/test judge from the generative author so an LLM never self-certifies control satisfaction without independent rule execution.

parameter_assignments.ca-02_odp.01: deterministic rule/script evaluation independent of generative model self-grading

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify all pass/fail release gates execute deterministic code rather than unverified LLM prompts.
